I booked a plane ticket with my family n.it: I booked a ticket with my family name twice and paid 40,000 yen at the counter, like a **penalty fee**
I booked a plane ticket with my family n.mean: money paid for breaking a rule or deal

A failure story with a plane ticket 🐧.it: A failure story about a **loss** on a plane ticket 🐧

In the past, I made a big mistake with a.it: In the past, I had a big **one-time loss** with a flight booking.
In the past, I made a big mistake with a.mean: a large loss that does not happen often

When I went from Nagoya to Manila in the.it: Going from Nagoya to Manila, I booked with my family name twice (like Gojo Gojo), and paid 40,000 yen in **extra costs**.
When I went from Nagoya to Manila in the.mean: money you must pay on top of the plan

When you book a plane ticket, check that.it: When you book, do a **pre-check** of your name!
When you book a plane ticket, check that.mean: checking something before the real deal

Because even if the name is only a littl.it: Even a small name mistake can cause a huge **financial loss** 😢
